threat_event: Attacker uses the integrator's always-on remote access to the Mid-Continent legacy SCADA and issues unauthorized commands
threat_source: Cybercriminal or nation-state actor via the integrator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on integrator remote access with a shared account; flat network; no logs in the group SIEM (scenario gap 2)
existing_controls: Hardwired shutdowns at central facilities and compressor stations
treatment_plan: Disable the always-on path; integrator access only through group PAM with named accounts; segment the field offices; forward logs to the SIEM (POAM-012)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the Mid-Continent legacy SCADA servers and HMIs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported operating systems; backups on a local storage device that have never been restored; reachable from the shared jump servers
existing_controls: Manual rounds and shut-in procedures; nightly local backups
treatment_plan: Offline and immutable copies of SYS-P5 images; quarterly restore test; accelerate migration to SYS-P1 (due 2027-09-30)
owner: Mid-Continent operations manager

threat_event: Attacker on the field LTE management network logs in to field devices with default vendor passwords and changes setpoints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords on 2 cellular modem web interfaces and 1 rod pump controller found in P07; modem management passwords not vaulted
existing_controls: Private LTE with SIM authentication; device passwords changed 2026-09-15 for the 3 devices found
treatment_plan: Sweep all modems and controllers for default credentials; vault device passwords; block management interfaces from the LTE user plane (POAM-003)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: Loss of SCADA alarm visibility hides H2S alarms and tank high-level alarms
threat_source: SCADA or communications failure, or an attack on SCADA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 250 tank batteries rely on high-level alarms reaching SCADA to meet the SPCC overfill option
existing_controls: Hardwired shutdowns; wells stop on loss of tank level signal; portable H2S monitors
treatment_plan: Written alarm-loss procedure: shut in or start gauging rounds within 4 hours; test it at 10 batteries a year
owner: Production HSE director

threat_event: Attacker spoofs or alters telemetry on unencrypted licensed radio links
threat_source: Hacktivist or criminal with radio equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 30% of Permian sites use licensed radio links carrying legacy protocols without cryptographic protection
existing_controls: Radio licenses and fixed paths; SCADA plausibility checks on key values
treatment_plan: Replace radio links with private LTE by 2027-12-31 (POAM-011)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: A field technician changes PLC or rod pump controller logic without review and causes unsafe or unstable operation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 30% of field logic changes are recorded after the fact
existing_controls: Program repository for about 60% of controller models; monthly logic comparison for those models
treatment_plan: Change request before field logic changes; extend the repository and comparison to all models (POAM-007)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known exploited vulnerability on an OT DMZ server or SCADA server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 known exploited vulnerabilities on OT DMZ and SCADA servers past the 30-day target
existing_controls: Quarterly OT patching tested on the development SCADA system; EDR on SCADA servers
treatment_plan: Clear the backlog; monthly OT patch window for DMZ servers; compensating rules where patching must wait (POAM-004)
owner: Group OT Security Director

threat_event: Malware or misuse on unsupported HMIs at the Florida control room goes untraced
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 22 HMIs run an unsupported operating system; 2 shared HMI operator logins
existing_controls: Isolated HMI network segment; console physical access control
treatment_plan: Replace or allowlist the 22 HMIs; named logins (POAM-008, POAM-009)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: The predictive maintenance model lowers rod pump speeds wrongly or acts on bad data, causing equipment damage, lost production, or unsafe conditions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic speed changes at 640 Permian wells began in 2026-06 without safety review, change management, or council approval (scenario gap 8)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G6 model; SYS-P1; SYS-P2 rod pump controllers
existing_controls: Rod pump controllers enforce minimum and maximum speeds locally
treatment_plan: Return the model to advisory mode; safety management of change and council approval before any automatic action (P10; POAM-021)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: The hydrocarbon accounting SaaS vendor suffers a breach that exposes royalty owner data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor holds data on about 190,000 royalty owners and 2,600 working interest owners
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 reviewed each year; MFA for all users
treatment_plan: Add breach notice and cooperation terms at renewal; monitor vendor security ratings
owner: Production Accounting Vice President

threat_event: A fraudster changes a royalty owner's bank details and diverts payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner bank changes accepted by mail and email with limited verification
existing_controls: Signed change forms; separation of duties between owner maintenance and payment release
treatment_plan: Callback to the number on file for every bank change; hold first payment after a change
owner: Production Accounting Vice President

threat_event: A fire, power loss, or attack takes out the Permian IOC and failover to the BCC does not work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Failover tested annually (last 2025-10-14); field device restore never tested
existing_controls: Hot standby SCADA servers at the BCC; cross-trained controllers
treatment_plan: 2026 failover test by 2026-11-30; add a field device restore test (POAM-006)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: Recovery after a destructive attack on field controllers takes weeks because programs are not backed up
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLC and RTU programs backed up centrally for about 60% of models
existing_controls: Vendor field engineers; spare controllers for common models
treatment_plan: Central program repository for all models; offline copies (POAM-006)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: Unknown or unmanaged field devices are exploited because they are missing from the inventory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 85% of field devices have model, firmware, and address recorded
existing_controls: Passive sensors at the IOC and BCC; site surveys
treatment_plan: Complete the inventory from sensors and surveys (POAM-005)
owner: Group OT Security Director

threat_event: Seismic and reservoir data is stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large interpretation data sets on the group cloud platform; many contractors
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; MFA; project-based access
treatment_plan: Quarterly access recertification; egress alerts on bulk downloads
owner: Production Vice President of Subsurface

threat_event: A lost or compromised field tablet submits false gauge or run ticket data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,800 field tablets; volumes feed state reports and royalties
existing_controls: Mobile device management with remote wipe; reviewer approval of volumes
treatment_plan: Anomaly checks between tablet entries and flow computer reads
owner: Production Accounting Vice President

threat_event: A disgruntled controller issues shut-in or unsafe commands
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 controllers with control rights at the IOC and BCC
existing_controls: Named accounts; SCADA event logs of every command; supervisor review of shift logs
treatment_plan: Alert on unusual command volumes; two-person rule for mass shut-ins
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: Someone tampers with an RTU or controller at a remote well pad
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Thousands of remote pads; fenced and locked but unstaffed
existing_controls: Fenced, locked pads; door switches on control cabinets at batteries
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Production security and compliance lead (Low): cabinet intrusion alarms at batteries are in place and pad-level losses are small
owner: Production security and compliance lead

threat_event: A carrier or private LTE outage cuts telemetry from a field area
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 9,000 cellular modems; private LTE core at the IOC
existing_controls: Controllers fail safe on loss of communication; redundant LTE core
treatment_plan: Dual-carrier modems at high-risk sites
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: A departed contractor still holds SCADA access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Removal of field contractor SCADA accounts takes up to 5 days
existing_controls: Contractor accounts tied to SYS-G1 identities
treatment_plan: Same-day removal through the identity governance workflow (POAM-008)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: A phished field supervisor's account is used to reach production business systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Field staff training completion 88%; shared tablets at some field offices
existing_controls: MFA for all users; quarterly phishing simulations
treatment_plan: Field training push to 95%; short-form training at safety meetings
owner: Production security and compliance lead

threat_event: A SCADA vendor software update carries malicious code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Updates from the SCADA vendor are installed on SYS-P1 servers quarterly
existing_controls: Updates tested on the development SCADA system first
treatment_plan: Verify vendor signatures and hashes before install; supplier assessment (GR-09)
owner: Production Vice President of Operations Technology

threat_event: A hurricane disables the Florida control room and field communications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida Panhandle operations (about 4% of production)
existing_controls: Generators; Florida wells monitored from the IOC as backup; shut-in plan before landfall
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Production security and compliance lead (Low): existing shut-in plan and IOC backup are sufficient
owner: Production security and compliance lead

threat_event: An error in the volume integration service corrupts allocated volumes, state production reports, and royalty payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Daily automated interface between SYS-P4 and SYS-P3
existing_controls: Reconciliation of allocated volumes to flow computers before close
treatment_plan: Automated reconciliation exceptions before each payment cycle
owner: Production Accounting Vice President
